description: JSON Schema 2020-12 representation of every option declared in better_map/appserver/static/visualizations/better_map/formatter.html. Generated by scripts/build-formatter-schema.py; do NOT edit by hand. CI gate scripts/check-formatter-schema.py asserts this artifact matches the source HTML byte-for-byte after regeneration. See ROADMAP §3 G7.

acceptRemoteCamera.description: When ON, the map subscribes to `better_map.camera.lng/lat/zoom` dashboard tokens and moves the camera whenever they change. Use to drive the map from another panel, a deep link, or a programmatic `setToken`. Mirrors the outbound Publish camera state toggle above.
acceptRemoteCamera.title: Accept inbound camera tokens

allowPitch.description: When enabled, users can right-drag to tilt the camera and see 3D extrusions properly.
allowPitch.title: Allow pitch (3D tilt)

allowRotate.description: Right-drag rotates the map around its center.
allowRotate.title: Allow rotate

autoSwap.description: When a row's latitude is greater than 90 or longitude greater than 180, the values were almost certainly swapped. Choose how to handle it.
autoSwap.title: Auto-correct lat/lon swap

closePopupOnDrilldown.description: When ON, clicking a feature fires the drilldown but skips the popup — useful when a marker click should change the dashboard rather than open a richer view. The popup briefly flashes on click without this flag.
closePopupOnDrilldown.title: Suppress popup when drilldown fires

customStyleUrl.description: Only used when "Custom style URL" or "PMTiles" is selected above.
customStyleUrl.title: Custom style / PMTiles URL

demoPreset.description: One-click showcase mode. Picks a deterministic, bundled dataset and replaces the SPL result for this panel — even on a panel whose query returns nothing. Fleet telemetry shows time scrubbing, comet trails, and 3D cargo extrusion; Smart building IoT shows the indoor floor-plan overlay and per-sensor alarm state; Cyber incidents shows global hexbin aggregation, MITRE chips, and RBA risk colouring. Set back to `None` to restore the SPL result.
demoPreset.title: Fill with example data

x-enum-labels.cyber-incidents: Cyber incidents — global SOC view (600 events / 24 h)
x-enum-labels.fleet-telemetry: Fleet telemetry — Oslo last-mile (40 vans × 6 h)
x-enum-labels.iot-smart-building: Smart building IoT — Fornebu HQ (5 floors × 50 sensors)
x-enum-labels.none: None — use this panel's SPL results

enable3DExtrusion.description: Extrudes Polygon / MultiPolygon features along Z. Pitch and rotate are already enabled by default.
enable3DExtrusion.title: Enable 3D extrusion for polygons

enableChoropleth.description: Colors polygons by a numeric `value` property using the active palette.
enableChoropleth.title: Render polygons as choropleth

enableCrossPanel.description: Broadcasts pan / zoom / pitch / bearing as `better_map.camera.*` dashboard tokens. Other panels can mirror the view.
enableCrossPanel.title: Publish camera state

enableDrilldown.description: Clicks on a feature publish its properties as `FIELD_VALUE_DRILLDOWN` tokens.
enableDrilldown.title: Enable drilldown on click

enableExportShare.description: Adds "PNG" and "Share" buttons in the top-right. PNG downloads `better-map.png`; Share copies a deep-link with the current camera state.
enableExportShare.title: Show export & share toolbar

enableHoverPreview.description: Shows a small, dismissable-on-leave popup on mouseover, distinct from the click popup. Useful for "what is this dot" glance views in security investigation and supply-chain dashboards. Default off — NOC walls don't have mice.
enableHoverPreview.title: Enable hover preview popup

enablePopups.description: Clicks on a feature open a sanitized popup using the `popup`, `tooltip`, or `description` field. HTML is filtered through DOMPurify with a strict allow-list.
enablePopups.title: Enable popups

extrusionHeightField.description: Numeric property to use for extrusion height.
extrusionHeightField.title: Extrusion height property

extrusionScale.description: Multiplier applied to height (and base if set). Useful when units are not metres.
extrusionScale.title: Extrusion scale

featureJoinPreset.description: Requires the matching PMTiles file in `appserver/static/visualizations/better_map/presets/`. See README "Preset tilesets".
featureJoinPreset.title: Preset tileset

featureJoinPromoteId.description: The vector-tile feature property used to match your `id` field.
featureJoinPromoteId.title: Tileset id property

featureJoinSourceLayer.description: Vector source-layer name inside the tileset.
featureJoinSourceLayer.title: Tileset source layer

featureJoinUrl.description: Override the preset with your own vector tile or PMTiles URL.
featureJoinUrl.title: Custom tileset URL

heatmapRadius.description: Lower values produce sharper heat density.
heatmapRadius.title: Heatmap radius (px at low zoom)

hexbinAggregate.description: Drives the color ramp and the optional 3D height.
hexbinAggregate.title: Hexbin: aggregate mode

hexbinAutoDegrade.description: Coarser cells at low zoom, finer at high zoom. Override below to pin a resolution.
hexbinAutoDegrade.title: Hexbin: auto-degrade by zoom

hexbinResolution.description: Leave blank to use auto-degrade. Typical ranges: 5 (globe), 7 (country), 9 (city), 11 (street).
hexbinResolution.title: Hexbin: explicit H3 resolution

highContrast.description: Replace translucent backgrounds with solid black/white widget chrome. Helps WCAG AAA contrast for low-vision users.
highContrast.title: High-contrast mode

hoverHtmlField.description: Row field whose value populates the hover popup (HTML, sanitised). Defaults to `hover`. Use a separate field from `popup` so click and hover can show different views.
hoverHtmlField.title: Hover popup HTML field

idField.description: Used by drilldown, feature-join, and cross-panel coordination.
idField.title: Identifier field

indoorImageCoordinates.description: Top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left as lng,lat pairs separated by;
indoorImageCoordinates.title: Floorplan corner coordinates

indoorImageUrl.description: Drops a georeferenced raster over the basemap. Combine with the next field.
indoorImageUrl.title: Floorplan image URL

labelColor.description: Foreground text colour. Defaults to off-white for dark themes.
labelColor.title: Label color

labelField.description: Row column to use for the label text. Auto-falls-back to `label`, `name`, then `tooltip` when the chosen field is empty.
labelField.title: Label field

labelHaloColor.description: Outline / halo around the text for legibility over busy basemaps. Defaults to deep navy.
labelHaloColor.title: Label halo color

labelLanguage.description: Re-points every symbol layer's `text-field` at `name:<lang>`, with a fallback to the basemap's native `name`. Works on OpenFreeMap and other OpenMapTiles-based providers.
labelLanguage.title: Map label language

labelMinZoom.description: Below this zoom level, labels are hidden so they don't collide at world zoom. Default `3` = continent-or-closer. Increase to `5+` for very dense maps.
labelMinZoom.title: Label min zoom

labelOffsetY.description: How far below the marker the label sits, measured in text-height multiples. Default `1.1`. Increase if marker size is large and the label feels too tight.
labelOffsetY.title: Label vertical offset (em)

latField.description: Auto-detected from common aliases (`lat`, `latitude`, `y`). Override to point at a specific column.
latField.title: Latitude field name

layerField.description: Splits the data into multiple toggleable layers. A floating control widget appears top-right when more than one distinct value is detected.
layerField.title: Layer field

lockView.description: Stops Better Map from auto-fitting whenever the data changes; preserves user pan/zoom.
lockView.title: Lock view after first fit

lonField.description: Auto-detected. Override for non-standard column names.
lonField.title: Longitude field name

markerColor.description: Default marker color when no per-feature `color` property is supplied.
markerColor.title: Marker color

motionPaused.description: Dashboard-author initial value for the master pause. The user can flip it at runtime via the control panel. OS-level `prefers-reduced-motion` is still honoured on top of this.
motionPaused.title: Pause all motion (initial state)

palette.description: Drives heatmap, hexbin, choropleth, and feature-join color ramps.
palette.title: Sequential palette

pathAnimated.description: Scrolls a dashed pattern along each path to imply motion.
pathAnimated.title: Animated ant-path

pathArrows.description: Periodic arrow markers along each path showing direction.
pathArrows.title: Path arrow heads

pathColor.description: Default line color for routes / paths.
pathColor.title: Path color

pathIdField.description: Group rows by this field to draw routes. Each group becomes one LineString.
pathIdField.title: Path identifier field

pathWidth.description: Stroke width for paths in pixels.
pathWidth.title: Path width

pointRenderer.description: Auto switches strategy by feature count: markers under 200, clusters up to 5,000, heatmap above.
pointRenderer.title: Point renderer

popupAllowInlineStyles.description: Permits the `style` attribute on allowed tags so dashboard authors can colour severity numbers inline. Restricted to a CSS allow-list (`color`, `background-color`, `font-weight`, `font-size`, `text-align`, `padding`, `margin`, plus a few related shorthands); dangerous values (`url()`, `expression()`, `position:fixed`, `behavior:`, `@import`, `javascript:`) are always rejected.
popupAllowInlineStyles.title: Allow inline styles in popups

remoteCameraTokenLng.description: Override the default token name. Use if multiple Better Map panels need independent camera channels.
remoteCameraTokenLng.title: Custom longitude token

selectedFeatureField.description: Row column to match against the selection token's value. Default `id`. Must match the column the dashboard publishes into the selection token.
selectedFeatureField.title: Selection field

selectedFeatureToken.description: Name of a dashboard token; when its value matches a row's selection field, that row is bumped to a top emphasis layer with a halo and an optional fly-to. Leave blank to disable. Pair with `drilldown.setToken` on the panel to flow clicks into the same token.
selectedFeatureToken.title: Selection token name

selectedFlyToOnChange.description: When ON, the camera animates to the newly-selected marker's coordinates. Pairs with `Fly-to zoom` below. Disable for dashboards that want to keep the camera locked at an overview while emphasising selection.
selectedFlyToOnChange.title: Fly-to on selection change

selectedFlyToZoom.description: Target zoom level for the fly-to (1 = world, 22 = building). `8` default is a metro-area view.
selectedFlyToZoom.title: Fly-to zoom

selectedHaloColor.description: Ring colour around the selected marker. Use a vivid accent that contrasts with both the base palette and the marker fill.
selectedHaloColor.title: Halo color

selectedHaloWidth.description: Halo ring thickness. `0` = no ring (just the scaled dot); `4` default; `8+` for very dense maps where the selection needs to "punch through" the surrounding markers.
selectedHaloWidth.title: Halo stroke width (px)

selectedSizeMultiplier.description: How much larger the selected marker grows. `1` = same size (halo only); `2.5` default; `6` = dominant. Halo extends slightly beyond the scaled dot regardless.
selectedSizeMultiplier.title: Emphasis size multiplier

showControlPanel.description: Floating "⚙ Controls" widget. Lets the user enable, disable, and reset every fancy action (comets, marching dashes, marker heartbeat, breathing extrusion, camera auto-orbit), plus master "Pause all motion" and "Reset view" controls. Hide to lock the dashboard-author defaults.
showControlPanel.title: Show on-map control panel

showLabels.description: Renders a text label below each marker so operators can read site names from across a NOC wall without hovering. Default off — labels collide at world zoom; set Label min zoom below to control when they appear.
showLabels.title: Show labels

showLayerControl.description: Top-right floating widget driven by the `layer` SPL field.
showLayerControl.title: Show layer control widget

showPerfHUD.description: Overlay FPS, frame time, layer count, and free WebGL slots in the top-left for benchmarking. Disable in production.
showPerfHUD.title: Show performance HUD

showTimeScrubber.description: Floating bottom bar that scrubs through the data's time range.
showTimeScrubber.title: Show time scrubber

tileProvider.description: OpenFreeMap is the default - no key required. See README for hosting your own tiles.
tileProvider.title: Tile provider

tileProviderApiKey.description: Required for MapTiler / Stadia providers. Stored as a Splunk dashboard option, not as a server-side secret.
tileProviderApiKey.title: API key

timeField.description: When present, the time scrubber and comet trail are enabled automatically.
timeField.title: Time field

trailWindowMs.description: How long a point stays visible after the scrubber passes it. Default is 5 minutes.
trailWindowMs.title: Comet trail window (ms)

v2AiAssistant.description: Sidebar chat panel that calls Splunk_AI_Assistant_Cloud's SPL generator. Feature-flagged.
v2AiAssistant.title: AI Assistant chat

v2AiGeo.description: Resolves missing lat/lon for events by joining against `assets.csv` / `identities.csv`.
v2AiGeo.title: A&I geo-resolution

v2Brushing.description: Cursor-radius highlight; features outside the radius dim out.
v2Brushing.title: Brushing highlight

v2CommandPalette.description: Quick-action menu — toggle layers, jump to bookmarks, run presets, export PNG.
v2CommandPalette.title: Command palette (⌘K)

v2DrawTools.description: Polygon, rectangle, circle, line and point. Drawn GeoJSON is emitted as a dashboard token.
v2DrawTools.title: Draw tools

v2EsBaseUrl.description: Leave blank to use the current Splunk web origin.
v2EsBaseUrl.title: ES base URL (optional)

v2EsNotable.description: Click a feature to open it in Incident Review. Requires Enterprise Security.
v2EsNotable.title: ES notable drilldown

v2Geocoder.description: Free-text place lookup via Nominatim. Debounced; pan/zoom on select.
v2Geocoder.title: Geocoder (search box)

v2GeofenceLayer.description: Drawn-or-loaded polygons with SPL alert templates for in/out events.
v2GeofenceLayer.title: Geofence layer

v2Itsi.description: Renders the ITSI service tree as geo-positioned nodes + edges. Requires ITSI.
v2Itsi.title: ITSI service map mode

v2KmlLayer.description: Renders KML uploads via togeojson into markers, paths and polygons.
v2KmlLayer.title: KML import layer

v2Lasso.description: Freehand-polygon multi-select. Right-click the selection for an action menu.
v2Lasso.title: Lasso select

v2Measure.description: Click vertices to compute distance, area and bearing via turf.js. Copy-to-clipboard.
v2Measure.title: Measure tool

v2Mil2525Layer.description: Tactical symbols rendered via milsymbol. Driven by the `symbol_code` field.
v2Mil2525Layer.title: MIL-STD-2525 symbology

v2Minimap.description: Corner overview with viewport rectangle, synced to the main camera.
v2Minimap.title: Minimap overview

v2Mitre.description: Enriches features with the technique name + tactics from the `attack_id` field.
v2Mitre.title: MITRE ATT&CK overlay

v2Purdue.description: Colours markers by Purdue level (0–5) via the asset-register lookup.
v2Purdue.title: OT Purdue / IEC 62443 overlay

v2Rba.description: Aggregates accumulated risk scores per geographic bin. Requires the `risk` index.
v2Rba.title: RBA risk heatmap

v2ScenegraphLayer.description: Drone/truck/ship/aircraft canvas sprites with bearing-aware rotation.
v2ScenegraphLayer.title: Scenegraph (3D-style icons)

v2SideBySide.description: Vertical divider between two basemaps for visual comparison.
v2SideBySide.title: Side-by-side compare

v2Soar.description: Right-click a selection to POST entities to `phantom_forward`. Requires Splunk SOAR.
v2Soar.title: SOAR playbook trigger

v2SoarUrl.description: Only used when the SOAR integration is enabled.
v2SoarUrl.title: SOAR phantom_forward URL

v2SpatialQuery.description: Drawn shapes emit an SPL `where` geomatch template into `better_map.spatial_query` for downstream panels.
v2SpatialQuery.title: Spatial query (SPL emit)

v2TimeSplit.description: Same camera, two time windows (e.g. T-1h vs now) split by a vertical divider.
v2TimeSplit.title: Time-window split view

v2TripsLayer.description: Multi-track replay with trailing fade, tied to the scrubber.
v2TripsLayer.title: Trip replay layer

v2WindLayer.description: Particle system over a u/v vector field input.
v2WindLayer.title: Wind / flow particles

v2WmsLayer.description: Overlay arbitrary WMS GetMap services as a raster source.
v2WmsLayer.title: WMS raster layer

v2WmsLayers.description: Comma-separated list of layer names in the WMS service.
v2WmsLayers.title: WMS layer names (comma-separated)

v2WmsUrl.description: Only used when the WMS layer is enabled.
v2WmsUrl.title: WMS base URL

title: better_map formatter options
